intent: Decide whether codegraph evidence is sufficient to stop: ask noul questions about evidence sufficiency, whether another round is useful, whether required evidence is missing, and whether there is a contradiction; drive the answers from evidence fields with hit/miss heuristics, then label continue/stop decisions by threshold.

known_steps.text: the workflow runs at most 3 iterations
a noul question "evidence_sufficient" asks "Does the current evidence cover every part of the query so a code-locating answer can be returned without guessing?"
answer "B" when the field "evidence_status" contains "sufficient" with hit 0.95
answer "B" when the field "evidence_status" contains "sufficient" with hit 0.8 and miss 0.1
answer "B" when the field "missing_evidence" contains "missing", "true" with hit 0.9 and miss 0.05
answer "B" when the field "contradiction" contains "contradiction", "true" with hit 0.95

unknown_steps.text: a yes/no question "evidence_sufficient" asks "Is the evidence enough?"
the workflow runs at most three iterations
